name: enhanced-filesystem-mcp
description: High-performance MCP server for filesystem operations with caching, parallel execution, Git, Ollama, HTTP, SSH, and Windows automation
long_description: 26 tools across file I/O, search, Git, process management, Ollama LLM integration, HTTP, SSH, and Windows UI automation. ESM Node server with LRU caching, parallel execution control, and atomic batch operations with rollback. No native dependencies.

allowed_dirs.title: Allowed Directories
allowed_dirs.description: Comma-separated directory paths the server is permitted to operate on (e.g. D:\Projects,D:\Models,D:\Tools). Use full paths, not drive letters alone. For UNC, use the full share path like \\host\share.

max_parallel.title: Max Parallel Operations
max_parallel.description: Maximum concurrent file operations (defaults match i7-14700K core count)

models_dir.title: Models Directory
models_dir.description: Base path for download_tool auto-placement (HuggingFace, CivitAI, etc.)
